description: EnskAI is the platform football agencies run their business on. This app lets an agency's staff work their book from ChatGPT: search the shared player and club catalogue as well as their own roster, read the briefs clubs have sent and rank their players against them, review scouting reports and injury and career history, see which deals have gone quiet, and check contract expiries and agency finances. It also writes back — onboarding a player, filing a scouting report, moving a deal along, logging a club note or proposing a player to a club. Every call is scoped by the EnskAI backend to the signed-in user's organization and role.
